json_ld.description:
The Knockaround x Dogfish Head Torrey Pines Sport brings polarized aviator green lenses with anti saltwater coating and full UV400 protection to the craft beer faithful and saltwater devotees alike. Built to last from the cooler to the coast, these matte green frames are designed for those with larger faces and feature custom Dogfish Head detailing, white K logos, and metal spring hinges. FDA compliant, impact resistant, and ready for whatever the day reels in. Includes a custom microfiber cleaning pouch!

Polarized aviator green lenses with anti salt water coating
Full UV400 eye protection
Green frame with Dogfish Head design
Matte finish
White K logos
Metal spring hinges
Microfiber lens cleaning pouch included
FDA compliant impact resistant lenses
